const TAG = "[CL-RES][APPROACH-CLOCK]";

const DEBUG = true;

const p = __PAYLOAD ?? {};

const VISUAL_STEPS = 5;

const APPROACH_TOTAL_DX = 704 - 303; // ≈ 401px total travel

const STEP_DX = APPROACH_TOTAL_DX / VISUAL_STEPS; // ≈ 80.2px per trigger

const FINAL_STEP_FORCE_X = 707;

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "approachOriginX";

// Session-only runtime ledger

const LEDGER_ROOT_KEY = "__ONI_APPROACH_CLOCK_RUNTIME__";

const LEDGER_SLOT_KEY = "approachTriggerLedger";

const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log(TAG, ...a);

const warn = (...a) => DEBUG && console.warn(TAG, ...a);

const err = (...a) => DEBUG && console.error(TAG, ...a);

const esc = (v) => {

try {

return foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ? foundry.utils.escapeHTML(String(v ?? "")) : String(v ?? "");

} catch {

return String(v ?? "");

}

};

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

const safeString = (v) => String(v ?? "").trim();

const safeLower = (v) => safeString(v).toLowerCase();

const skipHidden = (reason = "", extra = {}) => {

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.hidePassiveCard = true;

p.meta.suppressPassiveCardUI = true;

log("SILENT SKIP", { reason, ...extra });

if (typeof context !== "undefined" && typeof context?.skipPassive === "function") {

return context.skipPassive(reason, { notify: false });

}

return;

};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Session-only ledger helpers

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function getLedgerStore() {

globalThis[LEDGER_ROOT_KEY] = globalThis[LEDGER_ROOT_KEY] || {};

const root = globalThis[LEDGER_ROOT_KEY];

if (!root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY] || typeof root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY] !== "object") {

root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY] = {

createdAt: Date.now(),

entries: []

};

}

if (!Array.isArray(root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY].entries)) {

root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY].entries = [];

}

return root[LEDGER_SLOT_KEY];

}

function resolveCurrentTurnOwner(combat) {

if (!combat) {

return {

ok: false,

reason: "no_combat",

combatId: null,

round: null,

turn: null,

combatant: null,

combatantId: null,

tokenId: null,

actorId: null,

name: ""

};

}

const combatId = safeString(combat.id);

const round = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

const turn = (typeof combat.turn === "number") ? combat.turn : null;

let combatant = combat.combatant ?? null;

if (!combatant && typeof turn === "number" && turn >= 0) {

const turnEntry = combat.turns?.[turn] ?? null;

const turnCombatantId = safeString(turnEntry?.id);

if (turnCombatantId) {

combatant = combat.combatants?.get(turnCombatantId) ?? null;

}

}

const combatantId = safeString(combatant?.id);

const tokenId = safeString(combatant?.token?.id ?? combatant?.tokenId ?? combatant?.token?.object?.id);

const actorId = safeString(combatant?.actor?.id);

const name = safeString(

combatant?.token?.name ??

combatant?.token?.object?.name ??

combatant?.actor?.name ??

combatant?.name

);

return {

ok: !!combatant,

reason: combatant ? "active_combatant" : "no_active_combatant",

combatId,

round,

turn,

combatant,

combatantId,

tokenId,

actorId,

name

};

}

function buildLedgerRecord({ combatId, round, casterName, turnOwnerName, attackerUuid, turnOwnerCombatantId }) {

const raw = `<${safeString(casterName)}><${safeString(turnOwnerName)}><${String(round ?? "")}>`;

const norm = safeLower(raw);

return {

raw,

norm,

combatId: safeString(combatId),

round: Number(round ?? 0) || 0,

casterName: safeString(casterName),

turnOwnerName: safeString(turnOwnerName),

attackerUuid: safeString(attackerUuid),

turnOwnerCombatantId: safeString(turnOwnerCombatantId),

recordedAt: Date.now()

};

}

function pruneLedgerToCurrentRound(store, combatId, round) {

const before = Array.isArray(store?.entries) ? store.entries.length : 0;

store.entries = (Array.isArray(store?.entries) ? store.entries : []).filter(entry => {

return (

safeString(entry?.combatId) === safeString(combatId) &&

(Number(entry?.round ?? -1) === Number(round ?? -999))

);

});

const after = store.entries.length;

log("LEDGER PRUNE", {

combatId,

round,

before,

after,

entries: store.entries.map(e => e.raw)

});

}

function ledgerGateCheck(record) {

const store = getLedgerStore();

pruneLedgerToCurrentRound(store, record.combatId, record.round);

const match = store.entries.find(e => e.norm === record.norm) ?? null;

log("LEDGER CHECK", {

candidate: record.raw,

candidateNorm: record.norm,

currentRoundEntries: store.entries.map(e => e.raw),

foundMatch: !!match,

match: match?.raw ?? null

});

if (match) {

return {

blocked: true,

match,

store

};

}

store.entries.push(record);

log("LEDGER STORE", {

stored: record.raw,

totalCurrentRoundEntries: store.entries.length,

currentRoundEntries: store.entries.map(e => e.raw)

});

return {

blocked: false,

stored: record,

store

};

}

async function postNarration(htmlText) {

let postedId = null;

const stripHook = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (chatMsg, html) => {

if (!postedId || chatMsg.id !== postedId) return;

const root = html?.[0] ?? html;

if (!root) return;

try {

root.querySelectorAll(

".message-header, .message-sender, .message-avatar, img[data-tooltip], .chat-portrait"

).forEach(el => el.style.display = "none");

const content = root.querySelector(".message-content");

if (content) {

content.style.marginTop = "0";

content.style.paddingTop = "0";

}

} catch (e) {

warn("Failed to strip chat header/avatar.", e);

}

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", stripHook);

});

const msg = await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.userId,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `

${htmlText}

`

});

postedId = msg?.id ?? null;

return msg;

}

function getTokenPlaceableFromResolved(resolved, attackerActor) {

if (!resolved) return null;

if (resolved?.documentName === "Token") {

return resolved.object ?? canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.document?.uuid === resolved.uuid) ?? null;

}

if (resolved?.object?.documentName === "Token") {

return resolved.object;

}

if (attackerActor) {

return canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.actor?.id === attackerActor.id) ?? null;

}

return null;

}

function getFreshTokenPlaceable(tokenDoc) {

if (!tokenDoc) return null;

return canvas.tokens?.get(tokenDoc.id) ?? canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.document?.id === tokenDoc.id) ?? null;

}

function captureTokenVisibilityState(token) {

const baseMesh = token?.mesh ?? token?.icon ?? null;

return {

tokenVisible: token?.visible ?? true,

meshVisible: baseMesh?.visible ?? true

};

}

function applyTokenVisibilityState(token, state) {

if (!token || !state) return;

const baseMesh = token.mesh ?? token.icon ?? null;

token.visible = state.tokenVisible;

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = state.meshVisible;

}

function hideTokenDisplay(token) {

if (!token) return;

const baseMesh = token.mesh ?? token.icon ?? null;

token.visible = false;

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

}

async function waitForTokenPosition(tokenDoc, expectedX, expectedY, timeoutMs = 250) {

const start = performance.now();

while ((performance.now() - start) < timeoutMs) {

const liveToken = getFreshTokenPlaceable(tokenDoc);

const liveX = Number(liveToken?.document?.x ?? liveToken?.x ?? NaN);

const liveY = Number(liveToken?.document?.y ?? liveToken?.y ?? NaN);

if (

Number.isFinite(liveX) &&

Number.isFinite(liveY) &&

Math.abs(liveX - expectedX) <= 1 &&

Math.abs(liveY - expectedY) <= 1

) {

return true;

}

await sleep(16);

}

return false;

}

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

globalThis?.context?.attackerUuid ??

"";

if (!attackerUuid) {

warn("Missing attackerUuid.");

return;

}

const attackerResolved = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerResolved?.actor ?? attackerResolved ?? null;

const attackerToken = getTokenPlaceableFromResolved(attackerResolved, attackerActor);

const attackerTokenDoc = attackerToken?.document ?? (attackerResolved?.documentName === "Token" ? attackerResolved : null);

if (!attackerActor) {

warn("Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

if (!attackerToken || !attackerTokenDoc) {

warn("Could not resolve attacker token/token document.", {

attackerUuid,

attackerName: attackerActor?.name

});

return;

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// NEW: session-only ledger gate

// Syntax: <CasterName><TurnOwnerName><RoundNumber>

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

const turnOwner = resolveCurrentTurnOwner(combat);

log("TURN OWNER SNAPSHOT", {

ok: turnOwner.ok,

reason: turnOwner.reason,

combatId: turnOwner.combatId,

round: turnOwner.round,

turn: turnOwner.turn,

combatantId: turnOwner.combatantId,

tokenId: turnOwner.tokenId,

actorId: turnOwner.actorId,

name: turnOwner.name

});

const casterNameForLedger = safeString(

attackerToken?.name ??

attackerTokenDoc?.name ??

attackerActor?.name

);

log("CASTER SNAPSHOT", {

attackerUuid,

casterNameForLedger,

attackerActorId: safeString(attackerActor?.id),

attackerTokenId: safeString(attackerTokenDoc?.id ?? attackerToken?.id),

attackerTokenUuid: safeString(attackerTokenDoc?.uuid ?? attackerToken?.document?.uuid)

});

// If there is no valid combat / turn owner, do not block the original behavior.

// Just log it and continue as the base script normally would.

if (turnOwner.ok && turnOwner.name && Number.isFinite(turnOwner.round)) {

const ledgerRecord = buildLedgerRecord({

combatId: turnOwner.combatId,

round: turnOwner.round,

casterName: casterNameForLedger,

turnOwnerName: turnOwner.name,

attackerUuid,

turnOwnerCombatantId: turnOwner.combatantId

});

log("LEDGER CANDIDATE", ledgerRecord);

const gate = ledgerGateCheck(ledgerRecord);

if (gate.blocked) {

return skipHidden("Approach already recorded for this caster/turn-owner/round.", {

ledgerRaw: ledgerRecord.raw,

matchedRaw: gate.match?.raw ?? null,

combatId: turnOwner.combatId,

round: turnOwner.round

});

}

} else {

log("LEDGER BYPASS", {

reason: "No active combatant / round owner resolved. Base script continues unblocked.",

turnOwner

});

}

const actorName = esc(attackerToken.name || attackerActor.name || "Creature");

const curValue = Number(attackerActor?.system?.props?.resource_value_1 ?? 0) || 0;

const maxValue = Number(attackerActor?.system?.props?.resource_maxValue_1 ?? 0) || 0;

if (!Number.isFinite(maxValue) || maxValue <= 0) {

warn("Invalid resource_maxValue_1; aborting.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

maxValueRaw: attackerActor?.system?.props?.resource_maxValue_1

});

return;

}

const currentDocX = Number(attackerTokenDoc.x ?? attackerToken.x ?? 0) || 0;

const currentDocY = Number(attackerTokenDoc.y ?? attackerToken.y ?? 0) || 0;

// Recalibrate origin when the clock is empty.

let originX = Number(await attackerTokenDoc.getFlag(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY));

if (!Number.isFinite(originX) || curValue <= 0) {

originX = currentDocX;

await attackerTokenDoc.setFlag(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY, originX);

}

const frontX = originX + APPROACH_TOTAL_DX;

// Already fully maxed -> no movement

if (curValue >= maxValue) {

await postNarration(`${actorName} stands in front of you`);

log("Already at max resource; no movement.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

curValue,

maxValue

});

return;

}

// Let the step that raises resource to 5 still animate.

// Only current value 5+ skips movement.

if (curValue >= VISUAL_STEPS) {

const nextValue = Math.min(maxValue, curValue + 1);

await attackerActor.update({

"system.props.resource_value_1": String(nextValue)

});

await postNarration(`${actorName} stands in front of you`);

log("Visual front already reached; incremented resource only.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

curValue,

nextValue,

maxValue

});

return;

}

// Normal move case

const nextValue = Math.min(maxValue, curValue + 1);

const nextVisualCount = Math.min(nextValue, VISUAL_STEPS);

const isLastVisualMove = nextVisualCount >= VISUAL_STEPS;

const targetDocX = isLastVisualMove

? FINAL_STEP_FORCE_X

: Math.min(frontX, originX + (nextVisualCount * STEP_DX));

const targetDocY = Math.round(currentDocY);

const dx = targetDocX - currentDocX;

if (dx <= 0) {

await attackerActor.update({

"system.props.resource_value_1": String(nextValue)

});

await postNarration(`${actorName} stands in front of you`);

log("Computed dx <= 0; incremented resource only.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

curValue,

nextValue,

currentDocX,

targetDocX,

isLastVisualMove

});

return;

}

const moveMs = 1150; // slow, ominous movement

const postMoveWaitMs = 180; // hold briefly at the end

const totalAnimMs = moveMs + postMoveWaitMs;

// Reverse-sync polish:

// Move the hidden real token shortly BEFORE the clone ends,

// then reveal it right as the clone should be disappearing.

const docUpdateLeadMs = 120;

const revealFrameDelayMs = 20;

const pseudoScript = String.raw`

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Approach pseudo animation missing casterToken.");

const dx = Number(params?.dx ?? 0);

const dy = Number(params?.dy ?? 0);

const moveMs = Number(params?.moveMs ?? 1150);

const postMoveWaitMs = Number(params?.postMoveWaitMs ?? 0);

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function getScaleSigns(token, baseObj) {

const docScaleX = Number(token?.document?.texture?.scaleX ?? NaN);

const docScaleY = Number(token?.document?.texture?.scaleY ?? NaN);

const meshScaleX = Number(baseObj?.scale?.x ?? NaN);

const meshScaleY = Number(baseObj?.scale?.y ?? NaN);

const signX =

Number.isFinite(docScaleX) && docScaleX !== 0 ? Math.sign(docScaleX) :

Number.isFinite(meshScaleX) && meshScaleX !== 0 ? Math.sign(meshScaleX) :

1;

const signY =

Number.isFinite(docScaleY) && docScaleY !== 0 ? Math.sign(docScaleY) :

Number.isFinite(meshScaleY) && meshScaleY !== 0 ? Math.sign(meshScaleY) :

1;

return { signX, signY };

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

}

const { signX, signY } = getScaleSigns(token, baseObj);

sprite.scale.x = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x) * signX;

sprite.scale.y = Math.abs(sprite.scale.y) * signY;

if (typeof baseObj?.alpha === "number") sprite.alpha = baseObj.alpha;

if (typeof baseObj?.angle === "number") sprite.angle = baseObj.angle;

if (typeof baseObj?.tint === "number") sprite.tint = baseObj.tint;

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

const startX = sprite.x;

const startY = sprite.y;

const endX = startX + dx;

const endY = startY + dy;

await animate(sprite, startX, startY, endX, endY, moveMs);

if (postMoveWaitMs > 0) await wait(postMoveWaitMs);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

}

`;

await postNarration(`${actorName} slowly approaches...`);

const updates = async () => {

await Promise.all([

attackerActor.update({

"system.props.resource_value_1": String(nextValue)

}),

attackerTokenDoc.update({

x: Math.round(targetDocX),

y: targetDocY

})

]);

};

if (game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

const tokenBeforeAnim = getFreshTokenPlaceable(attackerTokenDoc) ?? attackerToken;

const originalVisibility = captureTokenVisibilityState(tokenBeforeAnim);

const animStart = performance.now();

try {

hideTokenDisplay(tokenBeforeAnim);

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.approach.stepForward",

scriptSource: pseudoScript,

casterTokenUuid: attackerTokenDoc.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: Array.isArray(p?.targets) ? p.targets : [],

params: {

dx,

dy: 0,

moveMs,

postMoveWaitMs

},

meta: {

source: "CustomLogicResolution.Approach"

}

});

// Wait until shortly before the clone should finish.

const waitBeforeDocUpdateMs = Math.max(0, totalAnimMs - docUpdateLeadMs);

await sleep(waitBeforeDocUpdateMs);

// Snap the hidden real token into place before the clone ends.

await updates();

// Wait until the canvas token actually reports the new position.

await waitForTokenPosition(

attackerTokenDoc,

Math.round(targetDocX),

targetDocY,

250

);

// Reveal as close as possible to the clone cleanup moment.

const elapsedMs = performance.now() - animStart;

const remainingMs = Math.max(0, totalAnimMs - elapsedMs);

if (remainingMs > 0) await sleep(remainingMs + revealFrameDelayMs);

} finally {

const tokenAfterAnim = getFreshTokenPlaceable(attackerTokenDoc) ?? attackerToken;

applyTokenVisibilityState(tokenAfterAnim, originalVisibility);

}

} else {

await updates();

}

log("Approach step applied.", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

curValue,

nextValue,

maxValue,

originX,

currentDocX,

targetDocX,

targetDocY,

dx,

totalAnimMs,

docUpdateLeadMs,

revealFrameDelayMs,

isLastVisualMove

});

props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][ROBBED-BLIND-9999-IF-NO-IP]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No target found. Skipping.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

}

const currentIpRaw = targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0";

const currentIp = Math.max(0, parseInt(currentIpRaw, 10) || 0);

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const bonusBefore = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

let bonusAdded = 0;

// If target still has any IP, add no bonus damage.

// If target has 0 IP, add +9999 bonus damage.

if (currentIp <= 0) {

bonusAdded = 9999;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + bonusAdded;

} else {

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore;

}

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.robbedBlindIpCheck = {

targetName: targetActor?.name ?? "Unknown Target",

targetCurrentIp: currentIp,

bonusAdded,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor?.name,

targetCurrentIp: currentIp,

bonusAdded,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

(async () => {

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Number(ms) || 0));

// ----------------------------------------

const attackerResolved = attackerUuid ? await fromUuid(attackerUuid) : null;

const attackerActor = attackerResolved?.actor ?? attackerResolved ?? null;

const attackerTokenDoc =

attackerResolved?.documentName === "Token"

? attackerResolved

: attackerResolved?.document?.documentName === "Token"

? attackerResolved.document

: null;

const attackerTokenName =

attackerTokenDoc?.name ??

attackerActor?.name ??

"This creature";

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p?.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No target found. Skipping.");

return;

}

const targetResolved = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetResolved?.actor ?? targetResolved ?? null;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

}

}

await targetActor.update({ "system.props.current_ip": "0" });

console.log(TAG, "Target IP reduced to 0.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

ipBefore,

ipAfter: 0

});

// ----------------------------------------

// 3) Wait 1.5s, then pseudo fade-out + SFX

// ----------------------------------------

await sleep(1500);

const fadeMs = 500;

const soundSrc = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Fall.ogg";

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

const soundSrc = String(params.soundSrc ?? "");

function animateAlpha(obj, fromAlpha, toAlpha, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

obj.alpha = fromAlpha + (toAlpha - fromAlpha) * t;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

sprite.destroy(); // no destroy(true)

}

// Keep the real token hidden; the GM-side script will delete it shortly after.

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

}

`;

game.ONI?.pseudo?.play?.({

scriptId: "oni.robbedBlind.fadeOutSelf",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: attackerTokenDoc.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [],

params: {

fadeMs,

soundSrc,

soundVolume: 1.0

},

meta: {

source: "Robbed Blind"

}

});

// Give the fade-out a moment to finish before deleting the real token

await sleep(fadeMs + 150);

// ----------------------------------------

// 4) Delete the actual token

// ----------------------------------------

await attackerTokenDoc.delete();

console.log(TAG, "Attacker token deleted after fade-out.", {

attacker: attackerTokenName,

attackerUuid: attackerUuid || attackerTokenDoc.uuid

});

// ----------------------------------------

// 5) Print chat message without token speaker/profile

// ----------------------------------------

const safeName = foundry.utils.escapeHTML(attackerTokenName);

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: {

scene: null,

actor: null,

token: null,

alias: "\u200B"

},

content: `<div class="oni-vanish-msg">${safeName} disappeared...</div>`

});

// ----------------------------------------

// 6) Debug marker

// ----------------------------------------

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.robbedBlindResolution = {

targetName: targetActor?.name ?? "Unknown Target",

targetIpBefore: ipBefore,

targetIpAfter: 0,

attackerName: attackerTokenName,

attackerDeleted: true

};

})();
